call_points.text: **Plywood volume growth:** management targeted 10% volume growth for plywood in FY27.
**MDF volume growth:** management expects 25% to 30% volume growth in MDF in FY27.
**MDF margin sustainability:** management stated 17% MDF margin is sustainable as cost increases have been passed on.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates confidence in 16%+ MDF margin target

call_points.text: **MDF new facility capex:** total outlay is ₹425 Cr, with ~₹300 Cr in FY27 and ₹125 Cr in FY28.
**Gearing ceiling:** debt-to-equity is expected to peak at 0.70 to 0.72 before normalizing back to 0.50 to 0.60.
**Pricing actions:** price hikes of 5% to 10% implemented in MDF and 4% to 5% in plywood from April.
**Raw material inflation:** geopolitical crisis caused a 50%+ surge in chemical prices and higher war risk logistics costs.
**PVC and WPC commercial production:** commercial production commenced in April 2026 with 6m kg door and 3m kg door frame capacity.
**Furniture fittings JV:** Greenply Samet JV is guided to reach break-even around mid-FY28.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company received a favourable order under section 250 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 dated 31-01-2024, by the Ld. CIT(A), wherein, Excise Duty Exemption was treated as capital receipt for Financial Year 2012-13. Consequently, the Company received Income-tax refund of Rs. 1788.24 lakh and interest on Income-tax refund of Rs 786.70 lakh. As the said amount pertains to the period prior to demerger pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Greenply Industries Limited and Greenpanel Industries Limited, and in accordance with the agreement dated 24th January, 2020 between the said parties, 50% of the said amount (i.e., Income-tax refund of Rs. 894.12 lakh and Rs. 393.35 lakh for interest thereon) was shared with Greenpanel Industries Limited. Subsequently the Income Tax Department has filed an appeal before the Hon'ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench on 21-06-2024 The tax effect of the aggregate amount under litigation as on 31-12-2024 is Rs. 1764.23 lakh plus applicable interest upto 31-12-2024. If any liability arises as a result of the litigation before the Hon'ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench, 50% of such liability shall be borne by Greenpanel Industries Limited.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Income Tax Department/Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax
tax_litigation.status: The Hon’ble ITAT, Guwahati Bench, vide its order dated 15-12-2025, has dismissed the appeal filed by the Income-tax Department, thereby upholding the order of the Ld. CIT(A).

operating_notes.text: FY26 exceptional items of ₹14.57 Cr included a ₹2.70 Cr provision for diminution in the residual investment in Greenwud Panel Limited (Dubai), a ₹9.48 Cr financial guarantee provision and a ₹2.98 Cr advance write-off.
The Income tax Department conducted a search and seizure operation at business premises from 26 Feb to 2 Mar 2026; no assessment, demand or penalty order has been received as of the signing date.
Finance costs in FY26 included a ₹16.98 Cr foreign-exchange loss on long-term borrowings for the MDF plant, versus ₹2.42 Cr in FY25.
Plywood realisation per SQM was ₹254 in Q4FY26 and ₹248 in FY26.
MDF realisation per CBM was ₹30,508 in Q4FY26 and ₹31,152 in FY26.
Greenply Samet JV FY26 total revenue ₹44.27 Cr (100%), with the company's 50% share of loss at ₹25.4 Cr.
WPC and PVC plant commercial production commenced in April 2026 with peak revenue potential of ₹75 Cr to ₹80 Cr.
Flooring line expected to be fully operational in early Q2 FY27 with peak annual revenue potential of ₹70 Cr to ₹75 Cr.
New ContiRoll technology implemented in 2 plywood plants, with remaining 2 plants to be upgraded in FY27 for an outlay of ₹45-50 Cr.
Paid USD 1 mn financial guarantee for Greenwud Panel Limited, Dubai and took ₹9.48 Cr impairment provision in FY26 books.

timeline.summary: Greenply Industries Limited scheduled an earnings call on April 30, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST with Manoj Tulsian (Joint Managing Director & CEO), Sanidhya Mittal (Joint Managing Director), and Sanjiv Keshri (CFO) to discuss Q4 & FY26 performance.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹776.25 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹30.73 Cr.

Greenply Industries Limited’s Board, chaired by **KAUSHAL KUMAR AGARWAL (Vice President-Legal)**, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share (₹1 face value) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on August 25, 2026.
Greenply reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹776.2 Cr (+19.6% YoY, highest ever) and FY26 revenue of ₹2,739.0 Cr (+10.1%), with Q4 core EBITDA of ₹93.2 Cr at a 12.0% margin.
Manoj Tulsian resigned as JMD & CEO effective 30 April 2026 due to personal reasons, remaining as an advisor.
Kaushal Kumar Agarwal, Vice President-Legal, shared Q4 & 12M FY2026 earnings conference call recording on 2026-04-30 via company website.
In Q4FY26 call, Greenply guided FY27 volume growth of 10% for plywood and 25-30% for MDF, with ~₹480-500 Cr planned capex.
Greenply Industries paid USD 1 million under a financial guarantee for Greenwud Panel Limited (Dubai) and recognized a ₹9.48 Cr impairment provision in FY26.
State Consumer Commission ordered Greenply to pay ₹10.94 lakh plus interest to a consumer.

Greenply Industries Limited scheduled an earnings call on October 30, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST with **Sanidhya Mittal (Joint Managing Director)** and **Sanjiv Keshri (CFO)** to discuss 2Q & 1HFY27 performance.
